headline: Rayo favourites at home, but the finishing is the doubt
summary: Rayo host Elche on Saturday in La Liga. Across ten bookmakers, margin removed, Rayo are 54% favourites, and the handicap rates them about three-quarters of a goal the better side. The doubt is finishing: Rayo created 2.26 expected goals at Getafe last time out and drew 1-1. Elche are 18th on 7 points and give up 1.98 expected goals a game, so chances should come — Rayo's last 5 matches produced 17 goals, and over 2.5 is 52.4% likely.
read: Rayo Vallecano are clear home favourites at 54% against an Elche side 18th in La Liga with one win from nine, with the market rating Rayo about two-thirds of a goal the better team. Vallecas will be partly closed after the trouble at the Athletic match, and Elche arrive unbeaten in three but without a goal in their last two games.

facts.fact: Rayo are 54.0% favourites to win, more than twice Elche's 21.3% chance.
facts.meaning: The market sees a clear home favourite, not a close call.

facts.fact: Rayo's players did not train at the Ciudad Deportiva on Wednesday, 72 hours before kick-off, according to Mundo Deportivo.
The market makes Rayo about two-thirds of a goal the better team, fair line -0.67, with the handicap set at -0.75.
The market leans to over 2.5 goals at 52.4%, even though Elche have not scored in either of their last two matches.
facts.meaning: Slightly more likely than not to be a three-goal game or better, but only just.

facts.fact: Rayo created 2.26 xG at Getafe on Monday and still drew 1-1.
facts.meaning: They are generating big chances without turning them into wins — one victory in their last three.

facts.fact: Pathé Ciss, who has played 765 minutes this season, is available to face Elche after the Disciplinary Committee overturned his fifth yellow card on Rayo's appeal.
facts.meaning: A regular starter in Rayo's back line returns for a defence that is missing others.

facts.fact: Elche trained on Wednesday with one absentee: midfielder Marc Aguado, who has played 375 minutes this season, is out with an ankle injury.
facts.meaning: Elche arrive close to full strength, with the one hole in midfield.

facts.fact: Elche have allowed 1.98 xG per game across their last five matches.
facts.meaning: They give up chances even when the scoreline stays tight, as in their 0-0 at Villarreal.

sources.fact: Rayo Vallecano will serve a partial stadium closure and a €6,000 fine for the match against Elche, with only 143 tickets available to Elche fans.
Rayo Vallecano supporters' groups reject the punishment and maintain their protests against club president Martín Presa.
Pathé Ciss will be available to play against Elche after the Disciplinary Committee overturned his fifth yellow card of the season following a successful Rayo appeal.
Rayo Vallecano players did not train at the Ciudad Deportiva 72 hours before the Elche match, according to Mundo Deportivo.
Rayo Vallecano drew 1-1 at Getafe in their previous La Liga match, having taken the lead and playing over an hour with a numerical advantage for Getafe.

Spain's anti-violence commission has proposed bans and fines for 12 Rayo Vallecano supporters who threw paper airplanes and other objects onto the pitch, forcing the suspension of the La Liga match against Athletic Bilbao.
Elche goalkeeper Matías Dituro said the team is "on the right track" and "growing", noting they have taken five points from the last three games but "need to get a win" against Rayo Vallecano.
Dituro credited Elche's growth to the work of coach Anselmi and urged focus on the match at Vallecas.
